_comment_top: Global settings — install to ~/.claude/settings.json. Hook scripts installed at ~/.claude/scripts/. Cross-platform: bash required (Git Bash on Windows). See README.md.
_precedence: Scope precedence (high → low): Managed > Local (.claude/settings.local.json) > Project (.claude/settings.json) > User (this file). Deny rules accumulate across all scopes; first match of deny > defer > ask > allow wins.

attribution._comment: Replaces deprecated includeCoAuthoredBy. Turn off if you don't want Claude in your commit/PR trailers.

env._comment: Only vars verified against official Claude Code docs. cache-fix-wrapper exports CACHE_FIX_* separately — do NOT redefine those here. PYTHONIOENCODING + PYTHONUTF8: prevents charmap codec errors when Python stdout encounters Unicode (em-dashes, smart quotes, non-ASCII names in email/document parsing). CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL: enables native PowerShell tool support on Windows.

statusLine._comment: Optional statusline script. Remove this block if you don't have statusline.sh installed.

permissions._comment: deny > ask > allow. Deny rules survive --dangerously-skip-permissions and bypassPermissions. Hooks (plugin hooks.json) are the second enforcement layer.
